settings.notes: Monochrome closed-loop sculpture study. Only swept fibres contribute visible pixels and occlude each other. The closed bundle guide estimates lighting and broad shadows; it is neither painted nor an opaque visibility mask. All examples use fictional inputs.

limitations: Finite samples do not guarantee every possible input or full physical collision freedom.
Broad visible overlaps require visual review; projected strand crossings are a different measurement.
The generator is an isolated offline renderer; no phone rendering or personal recipe storage is implemented.
